narrative.text: I’ve read the findings. There’s one inconsistency: in review case B, the directory resolves to user 7, whose `user7@…` address passes the proposed `isSynthetic` check. The requested predicate would therefore still accept case B. I’ll ask which behavior you intend before changing that guard.The clarification confirms the per-participant check is intended. I’ll test refusal when the directory resolves to a participant with a real metadata address, and document that a genuine `user<own id>@…` address remains indistinguishable by shape. No domain rule will be added.The fixes are complete and the branch is squashed to one commit: `0c36b6f`, directly on `e5c4b4c`. Clean install, typecheck, build, and the full suite passed: 306 tests passed, none failed, and one platform-specific test was skipped. The report will include the clarified case-B limitation and final PR title and body.
